description: CLI commands for tunnel management operations

requirements.title: Status command shows tunnel health
requirements.description: tunnel-manager status displays: systemd status, /ready status, HA connections, error rate, management mode (local/remote), last recovery event

requirements.title: Status supports JSON output
requirements.description: --json flag outputs machine-readable health summary for scripting and agent consumption

requirements.title: Routes command lists all published routes
requirements.description: tunnel-manager routes displays a table: subdomain, scenario, expected port, status (up/down/degraded), last probe time

requirements.title: Probe command runs all probes
requirements.description: tunnel-manager probe runs internal + external probes on all enabled routes and displays results with classification (up, tunnel-issue, scenario-down)

requirements.title: Audit command checks port compliance
requirements.description: tunnel-manager audit scans all manifested scenarios and reports: compliant, non-compliant (with expected vs actual), missing. Exit code 1 if any violations found.
